subject: medicine
title: Systemic lupus erythematosus and antiphospholipid syndrome

steps.tx: Ask about a **malar rash** over the cheeks that spares the folds, is photosensitive, and flares in sun. Ask about **discoid lesions** with scarring, hair loss and painless mouth ulcers, plus Raynaud colour changes of the digits. Ask about pleuritic pain and rubs suggesting **serositis**, joint pains that bend without eroding, strokes or miscarriages suggesting clots, seizures or psychosis, and drugs such as hydralazine and minocycline that trigger lupus.
steps.say: Ask about a butterfly rash over the cheeks that spares the folds around the nose, which suggests lupus, and flares in sunlight. Ask about scarring discoid lesions with hair loss and painless mouth ulcers, plus colour changes of the fingers in the cold. Ask about sharp chest pain on breathing and rubs that suggest inflammation of the linings, joint pains that bend without eroding bone, strokes or miscarriages that suggest clots, fits or psychosis, and drugs such as hydralazine and minocycline that can trigger lupus.

steps.tx: Look for fixed **malar erythema** that spares the nasolabial folds with photosensitivity, and for plugged scarring **discoid plaques**. Test small joints for **Jaccoud deformity** that corrects passively unlike rheumatoid erosion. Listen for pleural and pericardial rubs, map netlike livedo that marks clot risk, note leg and fingertip ulcers, check for nephritic oedema, screen the brain for psychosis, and dip urine with blood pressure while scoping the fundi.
steps.say: Look for fixed redness over the cheeks that spares the folds around the nose with sensitivity to sunlight, and for plugged scarring plaques on the skin. Test the small joints for bendy deformities that straighten passively, unlike the fixed erosions of rheumatoid disease. Listen for pleural and pericardial rubs, map netlike skin mottling that marks clot risk, note leg and fingertip ulcers, check for swelling from kidney inflammation, screen the brain for psychosis, and dip the urine, measure blood pressure, and scope the eyes.

steps.tx: This close facial view shows fixed **malar erythema** sweeping both cheeks while sparing the nasolabial folds, with scaly **discoid plaques** and **photosensitivity** labelled. Study the butterfly pattern because the exam rewards spotting fold sparing at a glance, and link it to sunlight driven flares when you counsel about protection.
steps.say: Look at this close facial view because it shows the classic butterfly rash of lupus. Fixed redness sweeps both cheeks while sparing the folds around the nose, with scaly discoid plaques scattered on the skin. Sunlight drives these flares, so photosensitivity matters for counselling. Learn this pattern well because the exam rewards spotting fold sparing at a glance, and link it to sun protection when you advise the patient.

steps.tx: Screen with sensitive **ANA testing**, then track flares with **anti dsDNA** titres and low complement that marks active consumption. Add specific **anti Sm** antibodies, classify kidney disease on biopsy to guide therapy, and test for clot risk with lupus anticoagulant, cardiolipin and beta2 glycoprotein. Expect cytopenias with Coombs haemolysis and protein with casts in urine, and separate rheumatoid, vasculitic, muscle and drug induced mimics with rheumatology input.
steps.say: Screen the patient with a sensitive antinuclear antibody test, then track flares with anti double stranded DNA titres and low complement that marks active consumption. Add specific anti Sm antibodies, classify kidney disease on biopsy to guide therapy, and test for clot risk with lupus anticoagulant, cardiolipin and beta2 glycoprotein. Expect low blood counts with immune haemolysis and protein with casts in urine, and separate rheumatoid, vasculitic, muscle and drug induced mimics with rheumatology input.

vis.alt: Microscopic image of a kidney biopsy showing immune complex deposits in glomeruli, characteristic of lupus nephritis.
vis.caption: Lupus nephritis biopsy: immune complex deposition guides classification

steps.tx: Anchor therapy on **hydroxychloroquine** with eye checks, strict sunblock and smoking cessation. Control organ threatening flares with pulsed **steroids** then taper, use **mycophenolate** for nephritis while avoiding it in pregnancy, prefer azathioprine when pregnancy looms, and add belimumab for refractory disease. Give lifelong **warfarin** when clot markers stay positive, vaccinate against infection, watch SSA heart block in pregnancy, and follow dsDNA with complement and urine.
steps.say: Anchor therapy on hydroxychloroquine with eye checks, strict sunblock and smoking cessation. Control organ threatening flares with pulsed steroids that you taper, use mycophenolate for kidney disease while avoiding it in pregnancy, prefer azathioprine when pregnancy looms, and add belimumab for refractory disease. Give lifelong warfarin when clot markers stay positive, vaccinate against infection, watch for heart block in SSA positive pregnancy, and follow DNA titres with complement and urine.
